headSubject: feat(path-a): P7.1 -- rank reuse > specialization > new concept > untrusted extension
summary: Closed Path A P7.2: added npdev_close_loop MCP tool wrapping 'npdev loop run' (intent-manifest 'request' -> diffGate -> validate -> classify -> generate+build+boot -> real acceptance-scenario runtime proof, one call, one traceable npdev-closed-loop-report.v1). Proving it live (not mocked) surfaced and fixed two real bugs: run_validate_semantic printed a second JSON doc to stdout inside the loop (Extra data on any real json.loads), and run_acceptance still hard-coded the pre-C2 'dev-key' default even though T1/C2 removed the dev profile's fixed admin key, so every scenario 401'd against a freshly booted app -- fixed by reading the boot's own apiKeyFile. Built a real corpus fixture (AppGen/apps/_scratch/p72-close-loop-proof, registered in corpus-roles.json) with a genuine additive model change and NL intent, and drove it through the actual MCP dispatch end to end to ok:true.
nextStep: Path A Phase 7 (the plan's final phase per its dependency chain P2.4+P3.5+P4.2--P7.1--P7.2) is now fully closed. BUT helpers/check_task.py --all still shows MANUAL (not machine-checkable, NOT necessarily incomplete -- P6.2/P6.4 also show MANUAL despite being closed by commits already on main) for P3.2 (per-element inheritance policy), P3.3 (lineage/specialization delta), P3.4 (parent-version drift policy), P5.1-P5.4 (object manifests, customization provenance, regeneration-conflict outcomes, golden regen-survival test), and P6.2/P6.4 (already done per git log). Before picking a next task: grep git log for P3.2/P3.3/P3.4/P5.1/P5.2/P5.3/P5.4 commit messages to see which are genuinely still open vs already landed and just unverifiable by the script. If P5's regeneration-conflict work is genuinely open, it is the more foundational gap (everything else in the plan assumes regeneration behaves correctly).
verified: NPDevCli tests.test_acceptance_runner + tests.test_closed_loop: 30/30 green after the api-key fix. NPDevMcp full suite (python -m unittest discover): 40/40 green, including 4 new tests for npdev_close_loop's argv construction; coverage.py measured NPDevMcp at 58% (was regressing to 53.05% against the 55.39% recorded floor before those tests were added). One real, live, non-mocked end-to-end run through the actual npdev_close_loop MCP dispatch (server.handle_request, not the bare CLI function) against a real generate+build+boot+acceptance cycle: ok:true, diffGate passed, validate 0 errors, classification SAFE_ADDITIVE, boot READY, 2/2 real acceptance scenarios passed. Did NOT re-run the full run-all-gates.ps1 after the fixes (ran it once before the api-key fix, found the coverage regression plus two pre-existing unrelated findings from last session's handoff (untriaged security-pattern hits, lineage-verify's missing corpusRole) -- neither touched -- then verified the specific deltas narrowly rather than repeating the ~8min full gate).
